title: 1992–93 National Hurling League
text:
{{Short description|62nd season of the National Hurling League}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox GAA League |league = 1992–93 National Hurling League |image =[[File:1993 National Hurling League final programme.jpg|250px]] |dates = 18 October 1992 – 22 May 1993 |teams = |team1 = Cork |captain1 = [[Brian Corcoran]] |manager1 = |titles = 13th |team2 = Wexford |captain2 = [[Tom Dempsey (hurler)|Tom Dempsey]] |manager2 = |oneb = |two = Laois |three = Roscommon |threeb = |previous = [[1991–92 National Hurling League|1991–92]] |next = [[1993–94 National Hurling League|1993–94]] }} The '''1992–93 National Hurling League''', known for sponsorship reasons as the '''[[Royal Liver Assurance]] National Hurling League''', was the 62nd staging of the [[National Hurling League]]. [[Cork GAA|Cork]] won the league, beating [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] by 3–11 to 1–12 after two replays of the final.{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}} ==Format== There are 12 teams in Division 1, divided into two groups. There are 8 teams in Division 2. Each team plays all the teams in its group once, earning 2 points for a win and 1 for a draw. Eight teams progress to the NHL quarter-finals: *The top three in Division 1A *The top three in Division 1B *The top two in Division 2 ==Division 1== {{Infobox football league season |competition=[[National Hurling League|National Hurling League Division 1]] |season=1992-93 |winners=[[Cork GAA|Cork]]

On 22 May 1993, [[Cork GAA|Cork]] won the title following a 3-11 to 1-12 win over [[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] in the final. It was their first league title since [[1980-81 National Hurling League|1980-81]] and their 13th National League title overall.
